coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping, fan running for air circulation, room kept quiet and dark.
Waking up, showering, washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed, using the shared bathroom before Member 3's 06:30 slot.
Daily reading of a book and light stretching, keeping quiet while other members use the bathroom and kitchen.
Preparing and eating a keto breakfast of eggs and avocado, checking the shared house calendar while eating, having breakfast alongside Member 1, Member 2 and Member 3.
Scrolling X and replying to Messenger messages about cancelled shifts under the lockdown.
Quiet desk study with the desk lamp on, reviewing Commerce and Engineering lecture notes on the computer.
Attending an online university lecture remotely because of the public-health lockdown, taking written notes.
Boiling the kettle for tea and making a low-carb snack, sharing a short tea break with Member 1 and Member 2.
Working on a Commerce and Engineering assignment at the desk computer in the quiet study space.
Cooking and eating a keto lunch of leftovers from the freezer, checking prices on a bargain-hunting app, eating alongside Member 1, Member 3, Member 4 and Member 5.
Washing up and loading the dishwasher and wiping down shared kitchen surfaces alongside Member 2 and Member 3.
Joining an online tutorial and posting questions in the unit group chat.
Reviewing the neobank budget on the phone, checking the list of six to ten subscriptions and cancelling unwanted ones.
Updating the monthly paper planner and noting upcoming assignment due dates and possible shift changes.
Revising for exams and drafting assignment sections at the desk.
Reading a book to unwind in a quiet, low-stimulation space.
Batch cooking keto meals for the week and preparing dinner, sharing the kitchen with Member 1, Member 3, Member 4 and Member 5 who are also cooking.
Eating dinner and reading news updates about the lockdown on the phone, alongside Member 1, Member 3, Member 4 and Member 5.
Portioning and freezing the low-carb keto servings and washing up, alongside Member 1, Member 4 and Member 5 who are also cleaning up.
Loading the washing machine with a load of laundry and starting it, using the bathroom right after Member 3's shower slot.
Sorting health and insurance paperwork, organising documents into labelled folders and writing down questions about the forms.
Reading quietly with reduced-motion settings on the phone to wind down while Member 1 uses the bathroom.
Quick evening wash, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed, using the bathroom after Member 1's evening wash and before Member 5's slot.
Reading in bed with reduced-motion settings on the phone before sleep.
Sleeping, with the room kept quiet and dark for the night.
